catalog.en: Calendar access is required to show fixed events on your timeline.
Face ID unlocks the encryption key for protected BOKKI Plan records.
Access is required to connect the timing and source of clinical records you allow with on-device health-management activities.
Access is required to compare the workouts, sleep, activity, vitals, nutrition, medications, and clinical records you allow with your timeline and create on-device automatic records.
Health write access is required to synchronize workouts and sleep records with your timeline.
Background location access records visited places and travel segments while movement logging is enabled. You can stop it in Settings > GPS & Sensor Data; continuous logging can increase battery use.
Location access records where you stayed and how long you traveled within the permissions you allow.
Microphone access is required to attach voice memos to action items.
Motion & Fitness access estimates walking, running, travel, steps, and floor changes while sensor collection is enabled.
Photo access is required to show photos on the timeline at the time they were captured.
